description: IMP-260b: the semantic crosses of the brief v2. An agent reports each one with verbatim quotes; the runtime checks the quotes sit in the places the rule allows. 'conflict' needs both ends; 'missing' quotes the source end and names where the counterpart should be.

rules.en: Scope (§6) against what the lenses describe
rules.es: Alcance (§6) contra lo que describen las lentes

rules.en: Business rules and actors (§2) against the process (§3)
rules.es: Reglas y actores (§2) contra el proceso (§3)

rules.en: Screens and messages (§4) against the technical lens (§5)
rules.es: Pantallas y mensajes (§4) contra el lente técnico (§5)

rules.en: Every visible field has an origin (or is marked orphan)
rules.es: Cada campo visible tiene origen (o está marcado huérfano)

rules.en: Every endpoint lives in a service or component
rules.es: Cada endpoint vive en un servicio o componente

rules.en: Every retention names the job that enforces it
rules.es: Cada retención nombra el job que la aplica

rules.en: Every obligation has a control and an acceptance criterion
rules.es: Cada obligación tiene control y criterio de aceptación

rules.en: Every system §5 takes as existing appears in §8 or as a fact
rules.es: Cada sistema que §5 da por existente aparece en §8 o como hecho

rules.en: Each story, its acceptance criteria and its §9 item agree
rules.es: Cada historia, sus criterios de aceptación y su ítem de §9 coinciden
